task_text: 确定给定两段6秒视频中，黑衣人物在 B 可见而在 A 对应位置不可见的全部时间区间。核查每段区间的起止边界，并说明定位精度及仍不确定的范围。
task_text_en: Determine every time interval in the two given 6-second videos during which the person in black is visible in B but not visible at the corresponding position in A. Check the start and end boundaries of each interval, and state the localization precision and the range that remains uncertain.

required_evidence.description: 两段视频在区间边界两侧的成对帧
diff_media 产出的逐帧差异图（差异时间线、差异框与成对放大），可替代成对抽帧作为差异位置的证据

requirements.text: 黑衣人物在 B 可见而在 A 对应位置不可见的时间区间（每段的起止边界，两侧时间）
requirements.text_en: The time intervals during which the person in black is visible in B but not at the corresponding position in A (start and end boundaries of each interval, on both sides)

requirements.text: 每段边界的定位精度（采样间隔）与仍不确定的范围；未核验区间不当作没有差异
requirements.text_en: The localization precision of each boundary (sampling interval) and the range that remains uncertain; unverified intervals are not treated as having no difference
